name: tilted phone answers a typed question
looks: A phone screen showing a portfolio dashboard sits at a shallow fixed tilt beside a headline. A short question bubble types on next to it, then a reply bubble fades in below with a specific figure picked out in the accent colour.
build: The phone is a DOM panel inside a perspective parent, rotateX/rotateY fixed at a shallow angle with a slow one-to-two-degree drift, soft blurred shadow beneath. The chat bubbles are DOM, the question typed on character by character with a blinking cursor, the reply fading and sliding up 4-6px after a short pause once the question completes.
sound: A soft slide as the phone settles, a light typing clack on the question, a gentle confirm tone as the reply appears.
prompt: Hold a product screen at a fixed, shallow 3D tilt beside a headline, with a short question typing on in a chat bubble next to it and a reply fading in below with one figure picked out in the accent colour. Keep the tilt still through the whole beat, only the chat content moves.
